# Michael Adamidis Arts

> > A digital art studio and brushware company showcasing concept art, oil paintings, and professional painting tools for Photoshop and Procreate.

Michael Adamidis is a digital artist and creator of MA-Brushes, a professional digital painting brush collection. The site features his artwork portfolio across multiple genres and serves as the official store for his digital art products and courses.

## Key Topics

- MA-Brushes
- MA-Brushes 2
- Michael Adamidis
- Digital Painting
- Photoshop Brushes
- Procreate Brushes
- Concept Art
- Digital Oil Painting
- MA-Colors
- MA-Textures
- Landscape Painting
- Portrait Painting
- Painterly Style
- Digital Art Courses
- Painting Tools

## Products & Tools

- [MA-BRUSHES 2 - The Most Realistic Digital Art Painting Brushes!](https://www.adamidis-art.com/ma-brushes-2): Product page for MA-Brushes 2, the advanced digital painting brush collection.
- [MA-BRUSHES Photoshop Painting Brushes - OFFICIAL Website](https://www.adamidis-art.com/ma-brushes): Official product page for MA-Brushes digital painting tools for Photoshop and Procreate.
- [Have the best colors for your next digital art painting!](https://www.adamidis-art.com/best-color-swatches-for-digital-art-painting): Product page for MA-Colors and MA-Textures digital painting tools and palettes.
- [Digital Painting - Brushes, Courses and Mega Bundles](https://www.adamidis-art.com/digital-painting-brushes-and-courses-tutorials-bundles): Product bundles page combining MA-Brushes, courses, colors, textures, and papers.
- [Photoshop Brushes, Digital Art Painting Courses + Tutorials](https://www.adamidis-art.com/digital-art-store): Store page featuring MA-Brushes, courses, tutorials, and product bundles.

## Art Portfolio

- [Digital ART Painting and Brushes - Michael Adamidis Arts](https://www.adamidis-art.com): Homepage showcasing Michael Adamidis' digital art, concept art, and MA-Brushes products.
- [Concept Art Painting - Michael Adamidis Digital Painting Art](https://www.adamidis-art.com/concept-art): Gallery of concept art, environmental design, and game art by Michael Adamidis.
- [Digital Oil Painting - Michael Adamidis Digital Painting Art](https://www.adamidis-art.com/digital-oil-paintings): Gallery of digital oil paintings created with Photoshop and MA-Brushes.
- [Graphic Design - Design Art - Michael Adamidis Digital Painting Art](https://www.adamidis-art.com/graphic-design): Portfolio gallery of graphic design and postcard work from Cologne-based projects.

## Courses & Learning

- [Digital LANDSCAPE PAINTING COURSE - Michael Adamidis Art](https://www.adamidis-art.com/digital-landscape-painting-course): Online landscape painting course with step-by-step techniques and video lessons.
- [Digital Painting tutorials and Concept Art time-lapse Videos](https://www.adamidis-art.com/video_gallery): Video gallery of digital painting tutorials and concept art time-lapse demonstrations.
